payload.title: Solutions stubs: fold or unlist; tag the newest research pieces client-acquisition
payload.description: Ten solution entries are 56 to 81 word stubs dated 2014 to 2023 (Marketo, Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Paytronix, Menu-Driver, Store-Driver, Ticket-Driver, Ticket-Driver-Copilot, Checkout-Driver, ticketing analysis). They sit beside the real case studies and date the section. Fold them into one 'Venue Driver integrations' page or remove them from the listing. Separately, the three newest research pieces (glide-decision-model-ten-seconds, openai-decisions-api-preview, can-averaging-reduce-noise) and decision-models-are-not-calculators have no client-acquisition tag and no /engage close; add both so the research-to-engage path covers them. Content repo.
